title: 3D nanobeam photonic crystal cavity, eighth model (FDFD eigenfrequency)
description:
The 3D version of examples/em/nanobeam_cavity_fdfd: a silicon nanobeam (n 3.48, 500 nm wide in y, 220 nm thick in z, along x) in air with a row of 12 air holes on each side of the centre (lattice a = 350 nm, r = 0.28 a, through the slab). The centre-to-centre gap L_def between the two innermost holes is the defect: L_def = 1.5 a adds half a period, a quarter-wave phase shift, which puts the localised resonance near the middle of the mirror stop band. Unlike the 2D effective-index model the mode also radiates out of the slab (up and down), so Q is set by the vertical light cone as well as the mirror leakage; all of it is absorbed by the CPML (8 cells on the hi faces). The beam runs into the x CPML.
Eighth model: the cavity centre is on the domain corner and all three planes through it are mirrors chosen for the fundamental TE-like cavity mode (E_y across the beam dominant, antinode at the centre): x_lo symmetric (PMC: E_y even about the cavity centre), y_lo antisymmetric (PEC: E_y even, E_x / E_z odd about the beam axis) and z_lo symmetric (PMC: TE-like, E_x / E_y even about the slab mid-plane). x_lo antisymmetric gives the odd cavity modes (E_y node at the centre); z_lo antisymmetric the TM-like ones. Integrals and maxima of the derived values count the mirror images (the whole cavity).
Graded mesh: a / 16 (21.9 nm) along the whole beam in x and across its half width in y, t / 12 (18.3 nm) through the half thickness in z, graded (ratio 1.3) to 80 nm in the air and the CPML; ~2e5 cells, ~6e5 unknowns; subpixel smoothing on the hole edges.
The target lambda_target is an estimate (Bragg wavelength 2 a n_B with n_B ~2.2, 1540 nm): the cavity mode is the high-Q row of the resonance table (Q_max); set lambda_target to its wavelength for the nearest-first ranking and the most accurate Q (the PML stretch is frozen at the target), and run without the sweep first to find it.
GPU: the eigen solver node 'eigen_gpu' uses factorization cudss_mixed (complex64 cuDSS LDL^T + float64 refinement, Rayleigh quotients; gpu backend, needs nvmath-python); 'cudss' is the full complex128 factor. Host SuperLU would need tens of GB of fill at this size.
Sweep tab: lambda_1, Q_1, Q_max and V_m_norm vs L_def (1.4-1.6 a). Derived values (resonance 1 = nearest the target, also the shown field): V_m = W_E / max(w_e) (the peak electric energy density mode volume) and V_m_norm = V_m / (lambda_1 / n_si)^3.
Field tab: |E|, Re E_y and w_e on the slab mid-plane (z cut) and the beam axis plane (y cut). Not yet run: the stop band and Q are unverified.

parameters.name: L_def
parameters.description: centre-to-centre spacing of the two innermost holes (the defect; swept)

parameters.name: x_first
parameters.description: x of the innermost hole (the cavity centre at x = 0)

parameters.name: L_mirror
parameters.description: innermost to outermost hole centre of one mirror (12 holes)

parameters.name: margin
parameters.description: beam beyond the outermost hole + a, before the x CPML

parameters.name: pad
parameters.description: air between the beam and the CPML (y and z)

parameters.name: n_bragg
parameters.description: estimated Bloch index at the stop band (sets the target only)

parameters.name: h_beam
parameters.description: cells along the beam (x) and across its half width (y)

parameters.name: h_air
parameters.description: largest (air) cells, also the CPML cells (19 per wavelength in air)
